notes: Screen and report rights of a user (FILE_PASSWORD / REPORT_PASSWORD, read by APP_SEC.can_page and APP_MENU_V); all screens / all reports of a system buttons, registry checks (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/SYSPASS.md)

FILE_PASSWORD.SYSTEM_NUMBER.lov: select system_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(system_desc_e, system_desc_a) else system_desc_a end d, system_number r from sys_systems order by system_number

REPORT_PASSWORD.SYSTEM_NUMBER.lov: select system_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(system_desc_e, system_desc_a) else system_desc_a end d, system_number r from sys_systems order by system_number

FILE_PASSWORD.FILE_SERIAL.lov: select file_serial || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(file_desc_e, file_desc_a) else file_desc_a end d, file_serial r from sys_files where system_number = :PAGE_SYSTEM_NUMBER order by file_serial

REPORT_PASSWORD.REPORT_SERIAL.lov: select report_serial || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(report_desc_e, report_desc_a) else report_desc_a end d, report_serial r from sys_reports where system_number = :PAGE_SYSTEM_NUMBER order by report_serial

USERS.MAIN_STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 order by store_code
